5. transform 必须先 X = X.copy()，不能修改输入；输入输出都是 pandas DataFrame，行数不变；

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin

from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind


class ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="构造历史月均消费与当前月费的比值特征，识别用户资费变动趋势",
        conditions=["numeric_features", "time_tenure", "string_typed_numeric"],
        dependencies=[],
        params={
            "monthly_col": "monthly_charges",
            "total_col": "total_charges",
            "tenure_col": "tenure",
            "output_col": "charge_ratio",
            "fill_value": 1.0,
        },
        parent="ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator@1",
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        monthly_col: str = "monthly_charges",
        total_col: str = "total_charges",
        tenure_col: str = "tenure",
        output_col: str = "charge_ratio",
        fill_value: float = 1.0,
    ):
        self.monthly_col = monthly_col
        self.total_col = total_col
        self.tenure_col = tenure_col
        self.output_col = output_col
        self.fill_value = fill_value

    def fit(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y=None):
        self.columns_ = list(X.columns)
        return self

    def transform(self, X: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        X = X.copy()

        required_cols = [self.monthly_col, self.total_col, self.tenure_col]
        if not all(col in X.columns for col in required_cols):
            X[self.output_col] = float(self.fill_value)
            return X

        # 安全转换 total_charges，处理潜在的空白字符脏数据
        if X[self.total_col].dtype == object or pd.api.types.is_string_dtype(X[self.total_col]):
            total = pd.to_numeric(X[self.total_col].astype(str).str.strip(), errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
        else:
            total = pd.to_numeric(X[self.total_col], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)

        tenure = pd.to_numeric(X[self.tenure_col], errors="coerce").replace(0, np.nan)
        monthly = pd.to_numeric(X[self.monthly_col], errors="coerce").replace(0, np.nan)

        avg_monthly = total / tenure
        ratio = avg_monthly / monthly

        # 处理除零产生的无穷大及缺失值
        X[self.output_col] = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(float(self.fill_value))

        return X
